Anna wrote about the day in the diary. Anna learned a lot about history. The weather was snowy that day. She declared that she would run for class president.
Anna hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Last Monday, Anna and Amy went to the classroom. Anna plays baseball with Amy every Monday. Also, he paid a fine for a minor misdemeanour downtown.
Amy is interested in singing. Anna is reading a book about history. Anna and Amy had great fun there. In fact, the final exam is next Friday.
Anna wants to be a nurse in the future. There are always many people at the reading room. Anna thinks history is interesting but a little difficult.
